title: Remission of Depression in One Day on Soft White Underbelly
subtitle: Accelerated TMS works.
body_html:
A couple weeks ago, I got a call from a patient. She had a relapse of her depression. She knew Accelerated TMS (aTMS) would work—it had once before. She also wanted the world to know recovery was possible.

I called Mark Laita to ask if her wish, to tell the world about aTMS, was possible to fulfill. Mark has YouTube channel with 1.6b views.

He said yes, and our re-treatment took place in front of his camera.

Thanks for reading—it's worth the full watch—the transformation is truly incredible. And thank you, Mia, for your bravery!
